scope: Iterative audit and correction of the ten object reference samples and editable Sky Lagoon context. Preserve approved panorama, castle anchors, gameplay and source originals. No runtime integration or new cinematic delivery.
finding_effect: Reference audit only; does not close runtime, exhaustive ownership or game-wide acceptance findings.
inventory: All ten v2 masters, their 66 isolated states, native generated sheets and current approved panorama/equipment/castle inspected or source-bound. Reuse every suitable state.
generation_gap: Swing poses change shell/ornament topology and jump in depth; add tightly constrained fresh intermediate pitch views to replace the defective sequence. No general scene regeneration. Review also reproduced berry-cluster teleportation in v2 states 4 and 5; six new leaf poses retain two fixed three-berry junctions.
required_evidence: Fixed hooks and rope-to-seat contacts per swing key
Grounded equipment and preserved anchor/pixel ownership
Scene overview and three playable-screen crops
Exact native Aseprite round trips and transparent margins
satisfaction_criteria: No observed clipping or opaque isolation backdrop
Swing fore/aft pitch around suspension axis; fixed frame and attached ropes
No observed changing object count or decorative topology in selected swing keys
Preserved panorama/castle identity and scenic path
All ten editable masters accessible from review gallery
